How We Work

A transparent consulting process in four stages.

Every engagement begins with a clear understanding of your needs and moves forward along a shared roadmap.

  1. 01

    01 – Introduction

    Understanding the organisation’s needs.

  2. 02

    02 – Analysis

    Assessing existing processes.

  3. 03

    03 – Strategy

    Preparing tailored recommendations.

  4. 04

    04 – Collaboration

    Carrying out the engagement within the agreed scope.

Stages

What happens at each stage?

01

01 – Introduction

In our first meeting, we listen to your organisation, your goals and your priorities.

  • An overview of the organisation’s structure and current situation
  • Clarifying expectations and priorities
  • An initial assessment of consulting needs
02

02 – Analysis

We assess current processes, relationships and opportunities within the agreed areas of focus.

  • Reviewing the relevant processes and workflows
  • Identifying strengths and areas for development
  • Assessing sector and regional conditions
03

03 – Strategy

Based on the findings, we prepare practical recommendations specific to your organisation.

  • Prioritised recommendations
  • A roadmap aligned with your goals
  • Agreeing on scope, timeline and way of working together
04

04 – Collaboration

We carry out the consulting engagement together, within the scope we have agreed.

  • Coordinating planned work with your teams
  • Regular reviews and updates
  • Adjusting priorities together when needed

Frequently asked questions

Common questions.

Which organisations do you work with?

We work with private hospitals, medical centres, clinics, medical companies operating in the healthcare sector, and international organisations seeking partnerships within the Turkish healthcare sector.

Which regions do you cover?

We are based in Bursa. In addition to Bursa and the surrounding region, we work across Türkiye and with international business connections.

Do you arrange patient referrals or treatment?

No. Our services are limited to business development, corporate relations and process consulting for organisations. We do not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, patient referral or medical tourism brokerage services.

How does the process begin?

Once you reach us via the contact form or WhatsApp, we schedule an introductory meeting to discuss your needs. The scope and way of working are then agreed together.

Is the information we share kept confidential?

Yes. Information about your organisation and the content of our discussions are handled in confidence; a confidentiality undertaking can be provided before an engagement on request.

Let’s work together

Let’s start with a conversation.

Schedule a short introductory call so we can understand your organisation’s goals and current situation.
